# Klar

Klar builds and runs the digital side of independent restaurants in Finland: your own website, your own online ordering and your own table bookings, with the guest list staying yours. Delivery apps take up to 30% of an order and booking platforms charge a fee per cover; Klar charges one flat monthly fee and 0% commission on sales. Based in Helsinki, serving Finland. Sites go live within 7 days, and hosting, same-day content changes, Google Business Profile care and a monthly report are included. Website and SEO on its own is EUR 50/month, bookings EUR 149/month, ordering EUR 199/month, and Klar Complete (website, ordering, bookings, guest CRM and SEO together) starts at EUR 249/month. All prices exclude VAT, and a one-time setup fee is quoted separately.

## Pages

- [Klar - restaurant websites, bookings and ordering](https://klarsystems.com/): What Klar provides, a calculator comparing what the platforms cost you against Klar pricing, the full plan pricing, and the founding partner program.
- [What Klar provides](https://klarsystems.com/what-we-provide/): Your website, bookings, ordering and your own guest list from one partner, what else is included, and the move off Quandoo before it closes on 30 September 2026.
- [Cost calculator](https://klarsystems.com/calculator/): Enter your monthly delivery orders, booked guests and share of regulars, and see what the platforms take today against what the same month costs on Klar.
- [Pricing](https://klarsystems.com/pricing/): Klar Complete from EUR 249/month with the Klar 300, 750 and 1500 usage bands, Klar Single plans, what decides the EUR 1,900-2,600 setup fee, and answers on commission, Wolt and who owns your data.
- [Contact](https://klarsystems.com/contact/): How to reach Klar, the free 30-minute visit to your restaurant in the Helsinki region, and how invoicing works when you start.
- [Founding partners](https://klarsystems.com/founding/): The founding partner program for the first 10 restaurants taking the full system: EUR 200/month + VAT locked whatever the volume, and 40% off the setup fee.
- [Privacy](https://klarsystems.com/privacy/): What Klar collects on klarsystems.com, why it is used, how long it is kept, and your rights under the GDPR.
- [Terms of use](https://klarsystems.com/terms/): The terms covering use of this website, the cost calculator, and the indicative pricing shown on it.
